description: Cosmic (registered 2026-10-13, B5 wiring): crust-level content only. A single stone crust biome whose height field stays inside the lower 256 blocks (the design's solid band); everything above it is air, standing in for the Empty -- the engine/worldgen JSON has no medium/atmosphere field, so the Empty cannot be named here yet (known gap). No carvers, no features: Recons, the Lattice Bridge, starship traversal and Hypervisor gating are game content that does not exist yet and is NOT represented by this file. Bound by design record: +/-262144 blocks (inside the packPos range); bounds are convention-only in the engine today, as for Wafer/Organic.
